children: iA Financial Group is pleased to announce that it has been named one of the ten highest-ranked companies headquartered in Canada in TIME’s World’s Best Companies of 2026.
The recognition reflects the company’s strong growth, positive employee experience, and commitment to responsible and transparent business practices.

TIME’s annual ranking is one of the most comprehensive global assessments of the top 1,000 companies worldwide based on three key dimensions: revenue growth, employee satisfaction and sustainability transparency.
A business model focused on revenue growth and sustainability

“We are proud to be recognized by TIME as one of the top 10 companies headquartered in Canada,” said Denis Ricard, President and CEO. “This recognition reflects the strength of our business, the commitment of our people and our ability to grow responsibly. We believe that investing in our employees’ learning and development strengthens our organization and helps us create lasting value for our clients, shareholders and communities.”

iA Financial Group has continued to deliver strong business growth across its operations. Over the past year, net premiums, premium equivalents and deposits increased by 25% and total assets under management and assets under administration grew by 37%, reflecting the strength of the company's diversified business model and its ability to meet the evolving needs of clients.

Our sustainability approach aims to create lasting value for our communities by combining financial performance with positive environmental and social impact. Guided by our business model, we focus on three priority areas where we can make a meaningful difference: physical, mental and financial health; education and learning; and a sustainable future. A learning organization where talent can grow

At iA Financial Group, we believe that when our employees get ahead, our company gets ahead. As a learning organization, we invest in the personal and professional development of our people through formal training, peer learning, on-the-job development, mentoring and continuous feedback. We also encourage employees to explore new opportunities across the organization, develop skills for different roles and build meaningful careers through internal mobility.

“We invest in our employees to give them meaningful opportunities to grow while strengthening our long-term performance," said Stephanie Butt-Thibodeau, Executive Vice-President, Talent and Corporate Affairs. “As a learning organization, we encourage employees to develop new capabilities, explore opportunities across the company and take an active role in building their careers. When our people grow, our organization grows with them.”
About iA Financial Group

iA Financial Group is one of the largest insurance and wealth management groups in Canada, with operations in the United States. Founded in 1892, it is an important Canadian public company and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol IAG (common shares).
